dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Well, we couldn't just drag Katheryne in here, could we? What would the real Adventurers' Guild do without her?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Not that she ever shows it on the outside, but she's one busy bee, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I mean, just think about how much time it must take to travel between all the different nations!

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Anyway, I heard this whole world was constructed from magic. Incredible stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Even the books on this shelf are real. Not a single prop to be found!

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Huh, I really gotta take a better look around once this gig's done.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Haha, not today, I'm afraid. The funds I need haven't transferred in yet.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Once I've earned enough Mora from this trip, I'll open up shop at the usual spot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The person who does this job is the one who gives me my daily Primogems, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: True... But it doesn't seem like the people who created this place set up anything like that. Hey, why don't I go ask for some, and then we all can have a few?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Huh, but could we even take them back into the real world, that's the question...
